name: Regional Security Force
description: Protects the borders of the Suerrat Republic from pirates, smugglers and undocumented immigration. A Suerrat career (Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4).

modifiers.description: DM-2 if you are aged over 30

field.name: Field
field.description: You are a field agent on a starship.

special_operations.name: Special Operations
special_operations.description: You are a member of the RSF combat forces.

6.title: Commissioner
6.bonus: SOC 10 or SOC +1, whichever is higher

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table, but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: A dangerous escaped criminal stalks you and your family. Now and each term until caught or you leave, roll Investigate 10+: succeed and the criminal is caught (DM+2 to your next Advancement roll); fail by Effect -6+ and lose one Contact, Ally or family member.
events.4: You establish a good network of connections. Gain two Contacts.
events.5: You are sent to research an elusive criminal syndicate. Roll Investigate 10+ to automatically advance this term.
events.6: You can manufacture an injury to ensure a criminal gets what they deserve. If you do, roll Athletics (dexterity) 8+: succeed and you are automatically promoted; fail and roll on the Injury table.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: A powerful criminal syndicate offers you a bribe. Accept and gain one extra Benefit roll each term you remain in this career; refuse and gain an Enemy.
events.9: You learn something that could destroy your supervisor's career. Withhold it and gain them as an Ally; exploit it for DM+2 on your next Advancement roll but gain them as an Enemy.
events.10: Advanced training is offered. Roll EDU 8+ to gain one of Leadership +1, Investigate +1, Advocate +1 or Athletics (any) +1.
events.11: A new member of the force is in legal trouble. Help them and gain Advocate +1; use their troubles and gain Deception +1.
events.12: You are decorated for heroism beyond the call of duty. You are automatically promoted.

mishaps.1: Severely injured (treat as a result of 2 on the Injury table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: A gunfight goes poorly and you now have a bullet lodged in an organ. Lose END -1.
mishaps.3: Your face is plastered all over criminal message centres. Gain SOC +1 but gain an Enemy.
mishaps.4: The ship you worked on is attacked by pirates. Roll Gun Combat (any) or Gunner (any) 8+ to avoid rolling on the Injury table.
mishaps.5: You make friends with a criminal you are pursuing. You are fired but gain them as a Contact.
mishaps.6: You are decorated for solving the impossible case. You are automatically promoted.
